airspaceAcrylicHeavy: Solid airspace takes acrylic covering the model {footprints, number, ::.0 group-off} times over. Plates or tiers use far less.
airspaceDataPartial: Airspace data is incomplete. Narrow the map area or turn off some airspace classes, then regenerate before exporting.
airspaceEmpty: No airspace pieces were made: no Class B, C, D or special use airspace reaches over this map area. Move the area over an airport or restricted area to build some.
airspaceEmptyClassesOff: No airspace pieces were made over this map area. {airspaceClasses, list, and} airspace nearby is switched off: turn it on under Airspace in acrylic to build it.
airspaceLabelsOmitted: {count, plural, one {# airspace sector label did} other {# airspace sector labels did}} not fit beside the rods and other labels. Full names and charted limits remain in the export manifest.
airspaceLevelsMerged: {count, plural, one {# airspace level was} other {# airspace levels were}} merged into the level below, because no rod fits between pieces closer than {gap, number, ::.0 group-off} mm. Raise Vertical exaggeration to separate them.
airspaceNotLoaded: Airspace was not loaded for this area, so no airspace pieces were made. Airspace data covers the US and its territories.
airspaceNotLoadedPreview: Airspace in 3D is not built in this preview; open the project in the studio to see it.
airspaceNoticeOmitted: The lowest acrylic level has no room for the navigation notice beside its rods. The assembly guide retains the notice and FAA cycle.
airspaceOverhang: {count, plural, one {# airspace sheet reaches past the rods that could stand under it. Reduce the model size or add supports under it before assembly.} other {# airspace sheets reach past the rods that could stand under them. Reduce the model size or add supports under them before assembly.}}
airspacePieceUnsupported: {count, plural, one {# airspace piece was left out because no rod could hold it} other {# airspace pieces were left out because no rod could hold them}} clear of the terrain and the pieces below. A thinner rod helps.
airspacePiecesDropped: {count, plural, one {# airspace piece was left out because it was smaller than 10 cm² after overlap partitioning, terrain and cropping cut it.} other {# airspace pieces were left out because they were smaller than 10 cm² after overlap partitioning, terrain and cropping cut them.}}
airspacePiecesOverlap: Airspace acrylic pieces overlap at the same height. Use plates or disable overlapping airspace classes, then regenerate before exporting.
airspaceTall: The airspace stands {height, number, ::group-off} mm tall. Lower the airspace ceiling cap or Vertical exaggeration for a model that is easier to build and display.
airspaceTerraced: {names, list, series}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} a floor given above ground, built as steps over the terrain.
airspaceTooComplex: Solid airspace would require {sheets, number, ::group-off} acrylic sheets, exceeding the {limit}-sheet limit. Use plates or tiers, thicker acrylic, or a lower ceiling cap, then regenerate.
annotationOmitted: {item, select, northArrow {North arrow} scaleBar {Scale bar} other {Title}} was omitted because it does not fit the material. Increase the output size or reduce the annotation size.
assemblyIdsOmitted: Assembly ids were omitted from {count, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} ({pieces, list, series}) because no position stayed hidden under the layer above.
aviationDataPartial: The aviation feature limit was reached, so some airspace, airports, navaids, or obstacles may be missing. Narrow the map area or turn off some aviation details.
aviationDataUnavailable: FAA aviation data is unavailable. This project cannot be exported until the data is restored or aviation details are turned off.
aviationNotCovered: FAA aviation data covers only the United States and its territories, so this area has no aviation detail.
aviationSymbolsFilled: Aviation symbols are less than ten aviation line widths across, so their inner detail engraves solid and airports, navaids and obstacles look alike. Enlarge the symbol size or thin the aviation line width.
bathymetryFallback: Some surveyed lake-floor data is unavailable. Gaps use existing terrain or modeled basins instead.
bathymetryGridMismatch: {lake} has {source, select, chart {depth chart} other {survey}} data that does not match the terrain grid, so its floor uses existing terrain or a modeled basin instead.
bathymetryGridMismatchUnnamed: A lake has {source, select, chart {depth chart} other {survey}} data that does not match the terrain grid, so its floor uses existing terrain or a modeled basin instead.
bathymetryIncomplete: {lake} has incomplete {source, select, chart {depth chart} other {survey}} coverage. Uncovered cells use existing terrain, modeled depths, or estimates near surveyed shores; cells without enough information remain at the waterline.
bathymetryIncompleteUnnamed: A lake has incomplete {source, select, chart {depth chart} other {survey}} coverage. Uncovered cells use existing terrain, modeled depths, or estimates near surveyed shores; cells without enough information remain at the waterline.
capsOmitted: {count, plural, one {# upper {unit, select, contour {contour} other {sheet}} was} other {# upper {unit, select, contour {contours} other {sheets}} were}} omitted because the circular crop retained no material meeting the minimum feature size.
elevationLabelsOmitted: Elevation labels were omitted from {count, plural, one {layer} other {layers}} {layers, list, series} because no collision-free position fit the exposed face.
elevationRepaired: Isolated depth spikes in the elevation data were replaced with estimates from nearby terrain. Review the terrain before cutting.
emptyLayer: Layer {layer} has no printable terrain at its elevation.
exportBlockAirspaceNotLoaded: Airspace was not loaded for this area. Turn off Airspace in 3D or regenerate after the service is restored.
exportBlockAirspacePartial: Airspace data exceeded the safe feature limit. Narrow the map area or turn off some airspace classes, then regenerate.
exportBlockAviationPartial: Aviation data exceeded the safe feature limit. Narrow the map area or turn off some aviation details, then regenerate.
exportBlockAviationUnavailable: FAA aviation data is unavailable. Turn off aviation details or regenerate after the service is restored.
exportBlockEmptyLayers: One or more layers are empty. Lower the vertical exaggeration, use thicker material, or reduce the minimum feature size, then regenerate.
exportBlockLakeDataUnavailable: Lake depth data is unavailable. Disable water depth or regenerate after the service is restored.
exportBlockLandsPartial: Public lands data exceeded the safe feature limit. Narrow the map area or turn off some land kinds, then regenerate.
exportBlockLandsUnavailable: Public lands data is unavailable. Turn off public land paint and boundaries, or regenerate after the service is restored.
exportBlockNotReal: Generate real terrain data before exporting {files, select, engraving {engraving} other {fabrication}} files.
exportBlockStale: Project settings changed. Regenerate the terrain before exporting.
exportBlockVectorPartial: Map detail data exceeded the safe feature limit. Narrow the map area or disable some map details, then regenerate.
railContextIncomplete: Covered railway data is incomplete. Regenerate, narrow the map area, or turn off Railways.
exportBlockVectorUnavailable: Map detail data is unavailable. Disable those map details or regenerate after the service is restored.
graphicLoosePieces: A cut graphic goes through the bottom sheet, so the islands inside its shape fall out. Engrave or score it instead, or keep them to glue back by hand.
graphicOmitted: Graphic {number} was omitted because it does not fit the material. Make it smaller or move it inward.
lakeDataUnavailable: Lake depth data is unavailable. Disable water depth or regenerate after the service is restored before exporting.
lakeDepthFromChart: Some lake floors come from a traced depth chart. They are only as accurate as the chart and its tracing.
lakeDepthPredicted: Some lake depths are estimated rather than surveyed. Modeled lake floors may differ from the actual underwater terrain.
lakePastEdge: {lake} extends past the edge of this map, so its depth could not be modeled. Zoom out to include its shoreline.
lakePastEdgeUnnamed: A lake extends past the edge of this map, so its depth could not be modeled. Zoom out to include its shoreline.
landsDataPartial: The public lands feature limit was reached, so some parks, forests, or preserves may be missing. Narrow the map area or turn off some land kinds.
landsDataUnavailable: Public lands data is unavailable. This project cannot be exported until the data is restored or public land paint and boundaries are turned off.
landsFromOpenStreetMap: This area uses OpenStreetMap for public land. It supplies unnamed national parks, nature reserves (shown as preserves) and military land where mapped.
landsNotCovered: No public land of the selected kinds was found in this area.
lowReliefContours: This area has very little elevation change; contour lines may be sparse.
lowReliefLayers: This area has very little elevation change; the layers may look nearly identical.
paintWindowsOmitted: Some paint windows on {count, plural, one {layer} other {layers}} {layers, list, series} could not be cut, so those areas are left off the stencils. Paint them by hand, or nudge the design and generate again.
seamSlivers: {count, plural, one {# cut piece is} other {# cut pieces are}} narrower than the minimum feature size. Glue the offcut in place with its neighbour, or raise the work area so the seam misses it.
seamTabsOmitted: Alignment tabs could not be placed along some seams on {count, plural, one {layer} other {layers}} {layers, list, series}; those pieces meet edge to edge. Glue them against a straight edge.
terrainSourceFallback: Higher-resolution terrain is unavailable for this area. The map uses the standard elevation source instead.
terrainCoarserZoom: Higher-detail elevation tiles were empty. This map uses original elevation tiles at zoom {zoom}.
transportationLabelsOmitted: Transportation labels do not fit the exposed material. Reduce Text size or Vertical exaggeration, or increase the artwork size.
vectorDataPartial: The map detail feature limit was reached, so some roads, trails, water lines, or boundaries may be missing.
vectorDataUnavailable: Map detail data is unavailable. This project cannot be exported until the map data is restored or those details are disabled.
waterDepthClamped: Water here is deeper than the {count, plural, one {# sheet} other {# sheets}} below the shoreline can hold, so its floor is flattened. Increase the depth-layer limit or turn it off for automatic coverage. Fit depth compresses lakes to the chosen allowance.
waterInsertFailed: {names, list, series}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {stays} other {stay}} wood: the shoreline could not be cut cleanly.
waterInsertOnBottom: {names, list, series}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {stays} other {stay}} wood: the waterline sits on the bottom sheet, so nothing would hold an acrylic insert.
waterInsertOversize: {count, plural, one {Acrylic insert {ids, list, series} is} other {Acrylic inserts {ids, list, series} are}} larger than the machine work area. Acrylic is never split, since a seam would show in the water; exclude the lake or use a larger machine.
waterInsertProud: The acrylic is {excess, number, ::.0 group-off} mm thicker than the wood, so the water will stand proud of its shore. Use acrylic no thicker than {wood} mm for a flush surface.
waterInsertTooSmall: {names, list, series}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {stays} other {stay}} wood: too small or narrow for an acrylic insert (under {minWidth} mm across).
waterInsertWholeSheet: {names, list, series}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}} {count, plural, one {stays} other {stay}} wood: the water covers its whole sheet, which would leave no wood to hold the acrylic.
workAreaOversize: {count, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} ({pieces, list, series}) remain larger than the work area. The seam grid stops at {divisions} divisions per axis; use a larger work area or a smaller model.
workAreaUnsplit: This work area would cut the model into about {pieces, number, ::group-off} pieces, more than the {limit} this tool emits. Use a larger work area or a smaller model.
bundledPreview: Bundled real-data preview. Generate fresh terrain before exporting.
samplePreview: Sample preview only. Generate real terrain before exporting.
mapServiceFallback: The map service was unavailable, so this preview uses deterministic sample terrain.
mapServiceFallbackBecause: The map service was unavailable, so this preview uses deterministic sample terrain. ({reason})
waterOutlinesFailed: Water outlines could not be applied, so the terrain has no water adjustment. ({reason})
depthChartMissing: The depth chart for {lake} is unavailable or has not completed contour review, so it is carved without it. Import a reviewed project file or recreate the chart from its source.
